api.title: API documentation
api.description: Complete reference for the Wavelet Platform backend API, covering authentication, users, tokens, and configuration management.

section1.title: General conventions
section1.desc: All API responses follow a unified envelope format.
section1.responseFormatDesc: All endpoints return the following JSON structure:
section1.errorMsgDesc: Empty string on success, human-readable error message on failure
section1.dataDesc: Business data; structure varies by endpoint
section1.authenticationDesc: The system supports two authentication methods. All protected endpoints require one of them:
section1.sessionCredentialDesc: Returned via Set-Cookie after login. Browsers carry it automatically.
section1.accessTokenCredentialDesc: Passed via Header. Suitable for API calls and third-party integrations:

section2.title: Authentication endpoints
section2.registerDesc: Create a new user account and log in automatically.
section2.passwordLoginDesc: Log in with email/username + password. Sets cookie on success.
section2.getProfileDesc: Returns the complete profile of the currently logged-in user.

section3.title: Access token management
section3.desc: Manage personal API access tokens (AccessToken) for non-browser API usage.
section3.listTokensDesc: Get all active access tokens for the current user.
section3.createTokenDesc: Create a new access token. Returns the secret once.
section3.isAdminDesc: Whether to grant admin permissions (default false)
section3.rotateTokenDesc: Generate a new secret for the specified token. The old secret is immediately invalidated.

section4.title: System configuration management
section4.publicConfigDesc: Returns all system configuration items marked as public. No authentication required.
section4.adminConfigsDesc: The following endpoints require admin permissions.

howToUse.title: User guide
howToUse.description: Quick start guide for Wavelet Platform, covering authentication, tokens, configuration, tasks, and observability.

section1.title: System architecture overview
section1.desc: Wavelet Platform uses a Go + Next.js frontend-backend separated architecture.
section1.architectureDesc: Go 1.25+ / Gin / GORM / PostgreSQL / Redis / Asynq
section1.authSystemDesc: Supports password login + OIDC third-party authentication
section1.accessTokenDesc: Personal Access Tokens for API calls

section2.title: Authentication & registration
section2.desc: The system supports multiple authentication methods, configurable via the admin panel.
section2.selfRegisterDesc: Users can create accounts via the registration page.
section2.bcryptDesc: Passwords are stored with bcrypt encryption.
section2.oidcDesc: Supports configuring any OIDC-compatible authentication source (e.g. Google, GitHub, enterprise SSO).
section2.oidcStep1: Add an authentication source in “System settings → Security”
section2.oidcStep2: Enter Discovery URL, Client ID, Client Secret
section2.oidcStep3: Once enabled, the login page will show the corresponding button

section3.title: Access tokens (AccessToken)
section3.oneTimeDisplayDesc: The secret is only shown once when the token is created.
section3.oneTimeDisplayHint: Copy and save it immediately after creation.
section3.secureHashDesc: The system only stores a SHA-256 hash of the token. The original secret cannot be recovered.
section3.headerUsageDesc: Include the token in the request header:

section4.title: System configuration
section4.desc: Manage system configuration dynamically via the admin panel or API.
section4.cacheAccelDesc: Public configuration items support multi-level caching (memory → Redis → database), performing well in high-frequency read scenarios.

section5.title: Async tasks
section5.desc: Distributed task queue system based on Asynq.
section5.schedulerDesc: Supports Cron expression configuration for scheduled tasks.
section5.workerDesc: Background worker processes consume and execute tasks.

section6.title: Observability
section6.tracingDesc: Supports exporting trace data to Jaeger, Zipkin, and other backends.
section6.structuredLogDesc: High-performance structured logging based on Zap, with level-based output.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Please read the following terms of service carefully before using Wavelet Platform.

section1.subject: Agreement parties
section1.subjectDesc: This agreement is between you and the operator of Wavelet Platform regarding the use of platform services.
section1.readCarefullyDesc: Please read all contents of this agreement before using the service. If you disagree with any terms, please do not use the platform.
section1.compositionDesc: This agreement includes the agreement text and all rules that the platform has published or may publish in the future. All rules are integral parts of this agreement and have the same legal effect as the agreement text.

section2.title: Service content
section2.liabilityDesc: This platform provides only technical infrastructure and development tool services. Users bear all responsibilities arising from their use of the platform.

section3.title: User accounts
section3.accountSystemDesc: After registering and obtaining an account on this platform, users should properly keep their account and password. Users are responsible for all actions under their account.
section3.passwordSecurityDesc: Users should use sufficiently strong passwords and change them regularly. Losses caused by improper password keeping are the user's responsibility.
section3.tokenSecurityDesc: Access tokens (AccessToken) are equivalent to account credentials and should be properly safeguarded.
section3.tokenLeakLiability: Any losses caused by token leakage are the user's responsibility.

section4.title: Usage rules
section4.desc: Users must comply with the following rules when using platform services:
section4.nationalSecurityDesc: Must not use platform services to produce, copy, or publish information that endangers national security.
section4.illegalInfoDesc: Must not produce, copy, or publish information that violates national laws and regulations.
section4.harmfulContentDesc: Must not publish information containing harassment, insults, intimidation, or other harmful content.
section4.ipInfringementDesc: Must not infringe on others' intellectual property, trade secrets, or other legitimate rights.
section4.otherIllegalDesc: Must not use platform services to engage in other acts that violate laws and regulations.
section4.enforcementDesc: If users violate the above rules, the platform reserves the right to take the following actions:
section4.enforcementAction: Warning, suspension, or termination of service

section5.title: Disclaimer
section5.basicDisclaimerDesc: The platform will make every effort to ensure service security and stability, but is not responsible for the following situations:
section5.techInterruptionDesc: Service interruption or data loss caused by:
section5.naturalDisaster: Natural disasters and other force majeure

section6.title: Governing law & dispute resolution
section6.applicableLawDesc: The conclusion, performance, and interpretation of this agreement are governed by:
section6.lawName: The laws of the People's Republic of China
section6.disputeResolutionDesc: Any dispute arising from or related to this agreement shall be resolved through friendly negotiation. If negotiation fails, either party may file a lawsuit with a court of competent jurisdiction.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Wavelet Platform values user privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.descriptionRights: Please read this policy carefully before using our services.

section1.title: Information collection
section1.desc: We collect the following types of information:
section1.authInfoDesc: Including username, email address, and encrypted password hash.
section1.authInfoNote: We do not store your plaintext password.
section1.logInfoDesc: Including IP address, browser type, access time, and request path.

section2.title: Information usage
section2.desc: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
section2.storageSecurityDesc: All user data is encrypted and stored in secure server environments.
section2.encryptionDesc: Passwords use bcrypt one-way hash encryption. Tokens use SHA-256 hash storage.
section2.accessControlDesc: Strict permission management ensures only authorized personnel can access user data.

section3.title: Purpose of information use
section3.desc: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
section3.identityDesc: Verify user identity and ensure account security.
section3.businessDesc: Provide, maintain, and improve our services.
section3.riskControlDesc: Detect, prevent, and handle security risks and fraudulent activities.
section3.prohibitedDesc: We commit not to use user information for: selling to third parties, sending unsolicited commercial promotions.

section4.title: Information sharing & disclosure
section4.sharingPrincipleDesc: We do not share personal information with third parties without user consent, except in the following situations:
section4.sharingException1: Required by laws, regulations, or government authorities through legal procedures
section4.sharingException2: Necessary to protect the platform's or the public's legitimate rights
section4.transferDesc: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or similar transaction, we will require the new holder to continue to be bound by this policy.

section5.title: User rights
section5.desc: Users have the following rights regarding their personal information:
section5.viewManageDesc: Users can view and modify their personal information at any time in their settings.
section5.deleteAccountDesc: Users can request deletion of their account and all associated personal data.

section6.title: Policy updates
section6.desc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. After updates, we will post a notice on the platform.
section6.notification: Significant changes will be notified via in-app notification or email.
